items.title: Alice Zeno Interview, 1960-01-25
items.q: There was two sisters, single. They were the Mazurros then. And I was raised there with them, right there in the house.

ctx.x: And then my mother used to work for the Renaissance family. There was two sisters, single. They were the Mazurros then. And I was raised there with them, right there in the house. And when my mother stopped working there, then she put me with me Jarot. For French.
Oh, I see. So you got very good teaching in French.
